verdict.rationale: Drata documents its own connections feature ('Understanding Connections in Drata') and a Custom Connections API for automating evidence collection. However, the pack only gives the article title, with no catalog contents, no evidence of native connectors for cloud, identity, HR, code hosting, MDM or ticketing, and no read-only scope documentation. The agent's 'READ ONLY' note concerns local system preferences, not integration scopes. missing for 10: a documented integrations catalog covering cloud providers, identity, HR, code hosting, MDM and ticketing; read-only scope/permission documentation per integration; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can connect my real stack — cloud providers, identity, HR, code hosting, MDM, ticketing — through a documented integrations catalog with read-only scopes

citations.quote: Connect on-premise tools and custom workflows to automate evidence collection.
